environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) in a private VPC subnet. The pod runs with default service account. pgBouncer 1.21 in transaction pooling mode fronts an RDS PostgreSQL 15 instance. The /internal/* routes are intended for internal service mesh traffic but no network policy or authentication middleware restricts access. The pod has unrestricted egress via a NAT gateway and can reach the EC2 metadata service (IMDSv1 enabled on node). No URL validation or allowlist is applied to stored callback URLs.
